calls.reconciliation: The three runs share one evidence base (the 2026-10-07 research traces) and land within $0.2B of each other on the median. Disputes: (1) Q3'24 beat (-0.1 vs +0.4B). From recall, Q3'24 guidance top was $158.5B and the actual $158.9B, so +0.4 is right. This doesn't change the conclusion: 2024 beats hovered near zero and 2025-26 beats were positive. (2) Q2'24 beat (-1 vs -2B). Recall gives guidance top $149B vs actual $148.0B, i.e. -1.0. Minor. (3) Consensus $202.1B vs $205.65B can't be settled without web access. $205.65B would imply ~14% growth despite the Prime Day headwind, which looks like an outlier or a stale pre-shift figure, so I give it little weight. (4) How much weight the recent beat streak gets versus the full-period median is a judgment call. I weight recent quarters more because AWS accelerated and both 2026 quarters beat by $1.6-3B. A cross-check from underlying growth (~16% minus the ~4pt Prime Day shift, minus FX) points the same way, toward ~$203B. I agree with the runs' dispersion and carry it forward. The tails outside $198-209B are small: below would need a large retail/FX miss, above would need a beat bigger than any in this history.
